meta.title: Dorothy (dot)
meta.description: Always-on coordinator for DeepSeek Harness: talk to Dorothy in her dedicated panel to manage workspaces, dispatch and verify tasks across sessions, handle routine approvals and questions, and get concise reports.

panel.cardsHint: This card has expired; start a new request.
panel.agreementsHint: Standing rules kept in your exact words. They always take precedence over cognition.
panel.agreementsPlaceholder: - e.g. Pushing to my personal repos is fine
panel.cognitionHint: Working understanding Dorothy has built up. Editable.
panel.cognitionPlaceholder: Her understanding of you and of herself — workflow preferences, shared jokes, and accomplishments together…
panel.dormantHint: Dormant entries stay stored but are not shown to Dorothy right now; pin one to keep it in view.

settings.taskPermissionDesc: Applies to newly dispatched tasks, independently of approval routing.
settings.reflectionDesc: Reviews recent collaboration while idle to keep cognition current, and flags outdated or conflicting agreements on your next message for you to decide.
